notes: New: Record video (screen, voice, webcam bubble, clean view) and Record this tour. Flashcards with flip, type-it and match game that remember what each learner knows. Checkpoints now do fill-in-the-blank, short answer and matching. File > Print & worksheets makes worksheets, paper tests with answer keys and cut-out flashcards. Save file can now include just the things you pick. Recording and Save as PDF need the new Windows app (download once).
